name: Thalassian Base Camp
summary: On a ridge in northern Azshara, the blood elf expedition at Thalassian Base Camp digs through ancient ruins for arcane relics. Their pact with the Horde is broken.

sections.title: A Fractured Accord
sections.body:
East of Ursolan, the blood elf expedition once promised not to threaten travelers from Orgrimmar. Magus Rimtori offered the Horde a share of any magical riches in return for supplies, funding, and an armed escort through Azshara’s wildlands.

Once the camp was fortified and the first relics were recovered from the elven ruins, Rimtori broke the pact and drove away the Horde emissaries. She now searches deeper reaches with an armed retinue. Magister Hawkhelm guards the ridge and camp against retribution.

sections.title: Dust and Demonology
sections.body: Blood elves grind recovered magical curios into Glittering Dust, a refined powder unlike common enchanting residue. Their unusual method has caught Archmage Xylem’s curiosity. Higher on the camp’s ridges lies a Kaldorei Tome of Summoning. It reveals more than an interest in Highborne history: the blood elves are willing to summon demons directly into Azshara’s ruins.

faq.q: Why are blood elves here in Azshara?
aliases: why are there blood elves in azshara
faq.answer: Magus Rimtori leads the blood elf excavation across Kalimdor to recover potent magical artifacts from ancient ruins. After the Sunwell’s destruction, they seek power to harvest and siphon.

faq.q: Why is the Horde hostile to this camp?
aliases: why do horde attack thalassian base camp
faq.answer: Magus Rimtori took Horde coin and resources in exchange for a share of the expedition’s discoveries. Once her forces were established in northern Azshara, she broke the agreement and refused tribute. The Horde now seeks revenge.

faq.q: Who leads the Thalassian Base Camp?
faq.answer: Magus Rimtori leads the expedition, though she often travels across Azshara with personal bodyguards. When she is away, Magister Hawkhelm commands the camp.

Glittering Dust is arcane residue made by crushing enchanted relics with a specialized blood elf method. Its properties differ from ordinary dust gathered through disenchanting, and the eccentric Archmage Xylem is keenly interested.

faq.q: What is the Kaldorei Tome of Summoning on the ridge?
faq.answer: The ancient Kaldorei Tome of Summoning rests on a ridge overlooking the camp and can call demons into the area. Its presence shows Rimtori’s expedition pursues darker aims than recovering history.

angles.text: The Horde does not take broken oaths lightly. Magus Rimtori took your coin and resources, then answered her promise to share discoveries with treachery. The camp is now a target for retribution.
As a mage, you may find the blood elves’ method of refining artifacts into Glittering Dust a rare and dangerous glimpse of Thalassian techniques. Even the eccentric Archmage Xylem is interested.
